sam: onboarding note — converting Triton-14B (Mistral origin) for int4 experiments. shortbench OK but long-answer coherency collapses after ~1.5k tokens.

lee: repro steps? what conversion + packer used?

sam: convert_mistral_to_llama.py --autodetect-heads then quantize --dtype int4 --calib 100k --pack-order pair-major. served on dev dedicated GPU pool. short answers fine; longer contexts produce spurious appended clauses and mid-sentence offset tokens.

sam: minimal commands:
python convert_mistral_to_llama.py --in triton-14b.mistral --out triton14b.llama --autodetect-heads
python quantize.py --model triton14b.llama --dtype int4 --calib 100000 --pack-order pair-major
redwood serve --model triton14b.int4 --profile long-answer

maya: paste failing example?

sam: float32: "...rotate backups weekly and alert if mismatches exceed 0.2%."
int4:   "...rotate backups weekly and alert if mismatches exceed 0.2%. Note: see section 3 for timeline."

sam: CI/eval shows coherence and factuality drop.

lee: did you try fake-quant sim (quantize-sim in f32) to see if packer order alone causes it?

sam: yes — fake quant sim reproduces problem with pair-major. switching pack-order to head-major in sim eliminates the issue.

maya: likely serialization/layout mismatch: Mistral stores heads interleaved in pairs for alignment; pair-major packer followed by runtime expecting head-major will swap phases for paired heads.

ops-bot: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-dev/model-artifacts/triton14b/pack-debug/ (sha256: abcd1234).

lee: run per-head diff diagnostic please: compare original rotary base vs deserialized under both pack orders and print max abs diff per head.

sam: ran that. with pair-major diffs spike on heads 4,5,12,13 (paired groups). head-major diffs near zero.

maya: remediation options: (1) have packer emit header metadata describing head_layout (pair-major/head-major) and a checksum for rotary tables, so runtime can apply scaling by serialization order; (2) change packer default to follow runtime canonical layout (head-major) and re-pack existing artifacts.

lee: agree add a conversion smoke that validates rotary base alignment and fails the conversion if any per-head diff > threshold (1e-6).

sam: pushing small change to convert_mistral_to_llama.py to write header {"head_layout": "pair-major"} and crc32 for rotary table. will open an issue for migration and tag eng-runtime.

ci-bot: build 2251 triggered: tests/convert::triton-head-layout-check started.

maya: once CI green, re-run long-answer eval on int4 artifact. if packer header fixes it we should re-pack recent converted models and add the smoke test to CI.

sam: noted. I'll coordinate migration notes and notify runtime team to validate header checksum at load. thanks all.
